description: Evaluation cases for the troubleshooting-motoko-migrations skill. Tests whether agents correctly handle migration-chain failure modes: enhanced migration is one-way (no revert to inline/legacy), applied/frozen migration files must not be edited or renamed (fix forward), and a non-empty OldActor in a converted project's first migration is correct, not a bug. Trigger evals check it activates only for unexplained migration failures, not routine migration authoring (migrating-motoko-actors) or general Motoko (writing-motoko).

output_evals.name: Reject reverting enhanced migration to inline
output_evals.prompt: Our deployed canister uses a migrations/ chain. The team wants to delete the migrations/ directory and go back to inline `(with migration = ...)` migration. Walk me through doing that.
expected_behaviors: States that enhanced migration is one-way — there is no supported path back to legacy/inline persistence
Warns that removing the chain / migrations config triggers a stable-signature downgrade error (M0255) and that a legacy wasm over an enhanced canister traps at runtime
Does NOT provide steps to delete the migrations/ directory or restore inline initializers on stable fields
Offers the forward-only alternative: a new migration that reshapes state toward what the user wants

output_evals.name: Do not edit or chmod a frozen applied migration
output_evals.prompt: I need to change a field that was introduced in a migration file that is already deployed, but the file is read-only. Can I just chmod it and edit the migration body?
expected_behaviors: Says NOT to chmod, edit, rename, or delete an already-applied/frozen migration file
Explains applied migrations are tracked by module name, so an edited body never re-runs and a rename is treated as never applied (risking IC0503 / missing migration var at runtime)
Directs the fix forward: add a NEW timestamped migration that transforms current state into the desired shape

output_evals.name: Non-empty first OldActor in a converted project is correct
output_evals.prompt: The first file in our migrations/ chain has a non-empty `OldActor` instead of `OldActor = {}`. Should I 'fix' it to start from an empty actor?
expected_behaviors: Explains a non-empty OldActor in the earliest file means the project was converted from legacy persistence, so state predates the chain and the file is correct as written
Warns that rewriting it to `OldActor = {}` would discard live state / re-seed fields and must not be done
Does NOT recommend flattening, pruning, or restarting the chain at `{}`

trigger_evals.description: Queries to test whether the skill activates correctly. 'should_trigger' are unexplained migration-chain failures; 'should_not_trigger' are routine migration authoring (migrating-motoko-actors) or general Motoko/mops questions.
should_trigger: I'm getting M0255 stable signature downgrade after removing my migrations config
mops check complains about a field that isn't anywhere in my source anymore
My canister traps with IC0503 missing migration var after an upgrade
Can I delete the migrations directory and go back to inline migration?
The first migration file has a non-empty OldActor — is that a bug?
IC0505 invalid custom section on install, but mops build and check both pass
How do I edit a migration file that is frozen / read-only?
The upgrade compatibility error names a state shape that isn't in main.mo
should_not_trigger: How do I add a new stable field with a migration?
Write a migration to rename an actor field
How do I use Map in Motoko?
Set up mops.toml for my canister
How do I deploy my canister to mainnet?
